scope_note: This identifies the first German edition; it does not assign the content of later expanded editions to the 1874 text.
statement: Wundt's Grundzüge der physiologischen Psychologie was first published by Wilhelm Engelmann in Leipzig in 1874.
statement_zh: Wundt 的《Grundzüge der physiologischen Psychologie》初版於 1874 年在萊比錫由 Wilhelm Engelmann 出版。
